theory: Workflows coordinate evidence-producing capabilities and control when a claim advances from proposal to approved statement, checked proof, and reportable artifact. Interactive work maintains durable mathematical state separately from local conversation and usage state. Completion is a guarded transition with explicit assumptions and holes, rather than a model declaration.
instead_of: A general agent loop could run all tools, but would not explain distinct approval, verification, document, persistence, and cancellation responsibilities or different interactive and unattended acceptance rules.

absorption.rationale: Owner ports support alternate callbacks and tools, but a configurable staged pipeline requires changing the fixed RunPhase graph and sequential ProveWorkflow orchestration. The model describes particular workflows rather than arbitrary plans.

world_mapping.rationale: Grades distinguish formal, faithfulness, informal, and document evidence; local and durable records have different portability; turn ownership represents dispatch/cancellation rather than mathematics.

abstraction.rationale: Extracted owners hold real responsibilities, but SessionRecord exposes mutable dictionaries and ProveWorkflow dependencies use Any/broad Callables. Invariants remain partly distributed caller conventions.

justification.rationale: Lock order, local-state portability, and evidence-backed grades have concrete explanations. Direct owner tests show changed assumptions refused and snapshot edits unable to mutate durable values.

honest_limits.rationale: Assumption probes explicitly remain heuristic; verified grades demand recomputable evidence; permitted assumptions are distinguished from those actually used.

rehearsals.requirement: Persist turn events and usage through another narrow sink.
rehearsals.why: TurnPersistence names event, usage, cursor, and thread callbacks without giving the coordinator an unrestricted session.

rehearsals.requirement: Add another formal-save refusal while preserving interactive compatibility methods.
rehearsals.why: FormalWorkspaceService owns saving and receives policy through the coordinator delegation.

rehearsals.requirement: Let operators assemble arbitrary pipelines with multiple independent verification and writeup stages.
rehearsals.why: The phase graph and sequential run coordinator encode one staged lifecycle; configurable graphs require a new plan/state model instead of another optional branch.
